title: Look Up and See the King
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Old Daniel saw a shining throne,
A ruler, old and bright;
His robe was white as falling snow,
His hair like wool, so white.

[Chorus]
Look and see, oh what could it be
Upon the clouds so bright?
It's Jesus, King forevermore,
Our King of love and light!

[Verse 2]
A stream of fire flowed out so bright,
And thousands gathered there;
Too many for a boy to count,
With wide eyes everywhere.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The Son of Man came with the clouds
Across the shining sky;
A kingdom with no end was His,
Our Jesus, King on high!

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Scout found a rainbow on the wall,
"Come, Mom, come look and see!"
When wonder's shared it grows and grows,
That's how it's meant to be.

[Chorus]
mood: Still, open music. A slow, even pulse under the voice, like a child standing very still in a hallway, watching a rainbow on the wall. A small celtic harp rolling soft broken chords, one low cello note held underneath like the floor. The verses stay hushed and wide-eyed; each chorus opens a little brighter, like clouds parting at midday, and the last one settles on a single clear held chord.
